name: Concealed Hydraulic Hinge
nameZh: 窄边三维暗藏液压铰链
summary: Zinc Alloy + Aluminium Alloy concealed hydraulic hinge.

specs.label: Installation direction
specs.value: Handed neither left nor right, top nor bottom

specs.label: Suitable door types
specs.value: Rebated door, aluminium-framed door, wooden door

specs.label: Three-dimensional adjustment
specs.value: In and out ±1.0mm / up and down ±2.0mm / left and right ±2.0mm

specs.label: Features
specs.value: 28mm narrow and 10mm slim; 45mm rebated door keeps a 4mm edge distance; Shallow frame routing that does not cut into the aluminium frame body; Fully concealed, closes flush when routed in; Hydraulic buffer with integrated damping; Three-dimensionally adjustable, precise and quick; Damping adjustable fast or slow, closing speed under control; 110° opening angle, self-closing with a silent buffer
